title: Production's screening opens only for the deployed tag's passing capacity report (decision 13)
assertion: The CDK app computes the launch value at synthesis from the report the deploy names, with the launch check, only for the tag's report from the Docker runtime that passes with time enforced, as recorded and as read again, measured at the tag's commit, on both images by config digest as ECR holds them for the stack's repositories (each manifest read from the registry, an index resolved to its linux/amd64 manifest, nothing pulled, whatever the deployer's image store; a registry not read, a platform manifest not found, no linux/amd64 manifest or an unexpected media type named) and with the web, the platform and the consumer at the sizes production declares; anything else stops the synthesis, naming decision 13 and each reason; no report keeps the screening closed; a value set by hand is refused (context of any spelling, and no ScreeningLaunch parameter is declared); a rule refuses a deploy whose image tag is not the report's; the consumer runs whenever a launch value is set, so no deploy opens the screening without it; the web keeps production closed unless the value names the image tag it runs; staging and development are not gated
noFileReason: The launch check reads synthetic capacity reports built in memory; no file.
